Pride and Progress News - highlights: 1. "Black and White Men Together" members Lidell Jackson and Mitchell Karp discuss racial discrimination at the Ice Palace COMMERCIAL: "New York Native" with Quentin Crisp 2. National Gay Task Force, interviews with members Peter Fowler and Evelyn White COMMERCIAL: "The Times of Harvey Milk" COMMERCIAL: "The Connection," gay and lesbian newspaper 3. Interview with Keith O'Connor, NYC Human Rights Commission, discussing anti-gay discrimination bill in NYC COMMERCIAL: Carnaval in Rio de Janiero, The Islanders Club 4. Report on Executive Order 50; employment rights for city contractors COMMERCIAL: New York Gay Film Festival 5. U.S. Court of Appeals for District of Columbia refused to hear case of expelled gay navy officer 6. Community announcements COMMERCIAL: Arco Blancos resort, San Juan, Puerto Rico 7. Heathline: Conversations with GMHC: Topic: AIDS Assessment Program of Community Health Project. Interview with Dr. Ted Lazarus, clinical coordinator AIDS Assessment Program, and Rona Affoumado, Admin. Director, Community Health Project COMMERCIAL: Badlands, NYC gay bar 8. Sports report
The Right Stuff: 1. Current Events COMMERCIAL: "The Times of Harvey Milk" COMMERCIAL: World of Video 2. Interview with Gary Miller, music director of the NYC Gay Men's Chorus, includes footage of chorus performing at Christopher Street Liberation Day Parade 1984 COMMERCIAL: New York Gay and Lesbian Film Festival COMMERCIAL: NGTF Fund for Human Dignity: gay and lesbian disabled 4. Interview with Quentin Crisp
